mapper.select: SELECT id AS work_case_id, status, starts_at, ends_at, workplace_latitude, workplace_longitude, allowed_radius_meters FROM work_cases WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND workplace_id = #{workplaceId} AND status IN ('READY', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND starts_at <= #{latestStartsAt} AND ends_at > #{earliestEndsAt} ORDER BY starts_at, id LIMIT 2

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN attendance_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND result = 'SUCCESS' THEN captured_at END) AS checked_in_at, MAX(CASE WHEN attendance_type = 'CHECK_OUT' AND result = 'SUCCESS' THEN captured_at END) AS checked_out_at FROM attendance_records WHERE work_case_id = #{workCaseId}
